segments.name: Medical Technology
segments.description: Develops and commercializes thin-film electrode, ablation and stimulation technologies for diagnosing and treating brain conditions and pain.
segments.evidence: The Company's Chief Executive Officer views the Company's operations and manages its business in one operating segment.

revenueModel.text: The company earns product revenue from sales of its electrode and ablation devices, including through a distribution agreement with Zimmer Biomet, and license revenue from collaboration and license arrangements.
revenueModel.evidence: We have a distribution agreement with Zimmer, Inc. ("Zimmer") providing Zimmer Biomet Holdings, Inc. with a license to commercialize and distribute the Evo Cortical, Evo sEEG, and OneRF Brain Ablation System in the brain.
